spec: docs/PRE_FRISCO_PROGRAM.md B5 (criteria: docs/I24_DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS.md §8.4.5 C1-C5, fixed 2026-10-07 before any run; the rule: docs/FRISCO_PROTOCOL.md Amendment 6)
status: PROPOSED, not adopted: a candidate is a proposal for the arm's demand level; adoption is the owner's call

selection.rule: among the scales whose mean inserted fraction over the fit seeds is at least min_inserted (the from-arm battery's mean realised share - 0.01), the largest share of fit-window flow bins with GEH < 5; ties to the smaller mean GEH over the same bins, then the smaller change |s - reference_scale|, then the smaller scale; no qualifying scale: constraint_unmet, nothing chosen (docs/PRE_FRISCO_PROGRAM.md B5, docs/FRISCO_PROTOCOL.md Amendment 6)
selection.reason: s = 0.925: GEH < 5 on 22 of 72 fit-window bins (0.3056, mean GEH 9.150; replicate_mean over 5 seeds), the best of the 7 of 10 scales whose mean inserted fraction is at least 0.9570 (this one 0.9654); tied on the share with s = 0.9, decided by mean_geh

coarse_selection.rule: among the scales whose mean inserted fraction over the fit seeds is at least min_inserted (the from-arm battery's mean realised share - 0.01), the largest share of fit-window flow bins with GEH < 5; ties to the smaller mean GEH over the same bins, then the smaller change |s - reference_scale|, then the smaller scale; no qualifying scale: constraint_unmet, nothing chosen (docs/PRE_FRISCO_PROGRAM.md B5, docs/FRISCO_PROTOCOL.md Amendment 6)
coarse_selection.reason: s = 0.9: GEH < 5 on 22 of 72 fit-window bins (0.3056, mean GEH 9.247; replicate_mean over 5 seeds), the best of the 4 of 6 scales whose mean inserted fraction is at least 0.9570 (this one 0.9855)

reproduction.what: the from-arm configuration (base x the carried scale, the from-arm's name) on the first fit seed, against the from-arm battery's replicate of that seed: the code tree reproduces the battery the criteria compare with

C2.rule: mean realised share >= the from-arm's - 0.01 (FRISCO_PROTOCOL Amendment 2 clarification: no winning by backlog)

C3.rule: hourly link-flow GEH < 5 share not below the from-arm's

C5.rule: the wave verdict unchanged where the from-arm passes
C5.note: the from-arm fails the wave row; C5 does not bind

section_lanes.what: the simulated count at every section: every lane of the section's edge ('all') or the observed lane set, lanes 1-4 ('observed'; docs/I24_CONSISTENCY_C7B.md §3). Reported, not gating: C3 reads each battery's link-flow criteria row as that battery scored it

refit.name: wave_speed
refit.threshold: backward wave speed in [14, 22] km/h (emergent, unseeded)

refit.name: sensitivity_grid
refit.threshold: penetration {1%, 2%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%} x compliance {25%, 50%, 80%, 100%} grid published with CIs

refit.name: no_collisions
refit.threshold: zero SUMO collisions in every run, each run recording the counter

refit.name: no_locks
refit.threshold: no run locked (no queue standing without discharge for 10 min or more), every run recorded

from_arm.name: wave_speed
from_arm.threshold: backward wave speed in [14, 22] km/h (emergent, unseeded)

from_arm.name: sensitivity_grid
from_arm.threshold: penetration {1%, 2%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%} x compliance {25%, 50%, 80%, 100%} grid published with CIs

from_arm.name: no_collisions
from_arm.threshold: zero SUMO collisions in every run, each run recording the counter

from_arm.name: no_locks
from_arm.threshold: no run locked (no queue standing without discharge for 10 min or more), every run recorded

refit.rule: a replicate realising less than 0.9 of its planned demand while the battery's mean realised share is at least 0.95 (coordinator's pre-registration 2026-10-07; reported, gating only by a later amendment)

from_arm.rule: a replicate realising less than 0.9 of its planned demand while the battery's mean realised share is at least 0.95 (coordinator's pre-registration 2026-10-07; reported, gating only by a later amendment)

estimators.gated: A5's values (and part (ii)'s C4's) are RMSPEs of the replicate-mean field: the replicates' mean 5-min segment-speed field, in 15-min windows, against the observed field (harness/corridor_b1.py battery 'rmspe_15min'); a battery's 'rmspe.value' (reported.rmspe_5min) is the same estimator in 5-min windows
estimators.intervals: a bracketed [mean, lo95, hi95] of RMSPEs is a 95% t-interval (harness/corridor_b1.py ci, paired) of the per-seed differences of per-replicate RMSPEs (each replicate's own field against the observed one: 'rmspe_15min_per_replicate', or the battery's 'rmspe.per_replicate_vs_observed' in 5-min windows), B1 + B2 minus B2 at the same seed; its mean is not the difference of the gated values (the RMSPE of a mean field is not the mean of the replicates' RMSPEs)

not_validation: a demand refit on the recording it is scored on (fit hour 06:30-07:30 inside the scored window; one morning, no holdout day): calibration, never validation
